draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Ridge Dynamics' setup
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for the note, and glad things are going well so far after our call last week.

Since your first project is up and running, the usual next step is bringing in a teammate: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so having someone else in there tends to make things click.

Happy to walk through that first invite with you on a short call this week if it's useful.

Best,
Chidi
